proposed_record.positioning: Cohere multimodal embedding model for text, image and mixed text-image document retrieval, classification and clustering.
notes: Cohere continues to list embed-v4.0 in the current model catalog with text, image and mixed text/image (PDF) inputs and a 128K context length.
Cohere now lists Embed v5 variants as newer embedding models, but embed-v4.0 is not marked deprecated in the current official model table.
No current public numeric PAYG API token rate for embed-v4.0 was verified, so pricing remains not-published rather than inheriting a rate from another Embed generation.

proposed_record.positioning: Cohere reasoning model for multilingual enterprise problem solving, tool use, RAG and agentic workflows.
notes: Cohere currently lists command-a-reasoning-08-2025 as Live with a 256K context window and 32K maximum output.
Cohere states that both trial and production API keys are free until rate limits are reached; no numeric pay-as-you-go token rate is asserted.
The model is excluded from the calculator because no paid Standard token rate is published for the Cohere API.
